prior_summary: Fresh-TCP local SE(3) targets reduce dependence on an absolute trajectory, while a registered causal encoder and masked five-class phase loss organize red-release, blue-approach, held-carry, insertion/release and retreat cues.
applicable_conditions: Prefer with drawer_position > 0.26 m when predecessor switch timing, TCP configuration or small tracking deviations are uncertain. Two causal frames must be retained across the switch; source_object is blue and destination_field blue_goal.
termination_guidance: Terminate only on the unchanged simultaneous evaluator expression. Do not use the auxiliary phase prediction, gripper state or TCP retreat as success proof.
limitations: Local increments can drift and provide no global collision-free route. Phase labels are heuristic observable categories, not contact truth. Large source/destination displacement is only conditioned. Drops, re-grasps, wall impacts and recovery are absent.
